bio: Please note that Afternoon Tea is served from 2:30pm - 5pm. Please specify 'Afternoon Tea' in the specific requests box when you process your booking.  The Montfort at Stanbridge Earls is surrounded by 32 acres of picturesque grounds, just minutes from the market town of Romsey.  Formerly a boarding school, The Montfort sits amongst natural woodland, open meadows and ornamental lakes making it perfect for a relaxing Afternoon Tea.  The Montfort Restaurant and Bistro is contemporary with a quintessentially English twist. Enjoy a tradional Afternoon Tea menu with Rare roast beef, smoked salmon and truffled egg sandwiches, scones with jam & clotted cream and a selection of sweet treats.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
